title: Lynchehaun
html_source:
Subject of a notorious crime story on a remote Irish island in County Mayo.
The then landlady and the estate became national and international news in 1894, when Mrs. McDonnell was brutally attacked by her bailiff, James Lynchehaun, and left for dead after he set fire to her house. His arrest, and subsequent escape were reported in the media, and became part of the popular culture of the era, with references to the affair in J.M. Synge’s drama The Playboy of the Western World, Joyce’s Ulysses (1922) and ballads of the time.
